facts.sourceTitle: Separate ARC2 and ARC3 team entries — dated public roster evidence
facts.text: On 19 October 2026, Mark Barney announced Jack Cole joining ARC Mutants for ARC-AGI-2. The public ARC2 roster lists jcole75, markbarney, scizical and sonphamorg under team 17023174. Team Turducken (ARC-AGI-3 team 15605182) is a separate entry; this announcement does not add Jack to that ARC3 team.
The listed menphim account directly links @menphim and the owned Takuma Mori professional page, which links back to Kaggle.
ARC Prize named Tufa Labs and its Duck agent the first-place open-source solution for the June 2026 ARC-AGI-3 Milestone 1 prize.

facts.sourceTitle: Tufa Labs — Duck Harness technical overview
facts.text: Tufa Labs says its public Duck harness lets an LLM inspect game grids as image and text, write Python in a REPL, and keep context short by evicting older messages. This describes the published Milestone 1 system, not an unverified current submission.
Tufa Labs lists Dries Smit, Isaiah Pressman and Jeroen Cottaar among its AI researchers, with research interests spanning reinforcement learning, self-play and Bayesian methods.

facts.sourceTitle: Tufa Labs — October 9 public competition post
facts.text: On October 9, 2026, Tufa Labs described a temporary setback in a public X post and said it remained dedicated to crushing competitors with overwhelming resources and compute.

facts.sourceTitle: Artificial Agency Lab — research and ARC-AGI-3 project
facts.text: Artificial Agency Lab says it built an ARC-AGI-3 agent combining structured grids and image observations with persistent context updates, keeping model weights fixed; it reports an eighth-place June milestone result.

facts.sourceTitle: Manifund — Artificial Agency ARC-AGI-3 project proposal
facts.text: A public ARC-AGI-3 project proposal names Richard Csaky as research lead and Côme Chevalier for engineering. The proposal describes an intended curiosity-driven proof of concept, not a verified method of the current Kaggle submission.
Richard Csaky’s Kaggle account published an “ARC-AGI-3 milestone 2 submission” notebook.

facts.sourceTitle: Artificial Agency Lab — own research and account links
facts.text: Artificial Agency Lab’s own site links Richard Csaky to @ricsinaruto and its September 30 ARC-AGI-3 submission; its dated historical methods do not identify the method behind the October 14 score event.
The sole rostered michaeltgao Kaggle account displays the public name Michael; the profile does not establish a surname.
